messages.t:
I'm Detective Theo Marsh. I have parts of the investigation file. What I don't have is the complete wedding ledger. You do.

I've been going back through the evidence the original investigation used against Jasmine.

There's something bothering me about it.

The case against her is built around what she did before Margery died.

I'm interested in what happened after Margery left the reception.

Let's start with the evidence I can recover.

I went back through the CCTV report.

Most of the reception was covered, but there was a gap in the camera coverage. The report places the blind spot around Tables 46 through 50.

That's important, but it doesn't tell us who was there.

Check that section of the wedding ledger for me.

What count do you get?

That's still too many people.

I went back to the physical evidence.

There's a handwritten mark on one of the items recovered during the investigation. It's damaged, but I can make out what might be a first initial.

T, H, J, or I.

I'm not confident enough to say which one it is.

See what that does to the group.

What count do you get?
